title: Selenium Induces Ferroptosis in Colorectal Cancer Cells via Direct Interaction with Nrf2 and Gpx4.
authors: Zhao, Mengxue; Xu, Mengyao; Zhang, Wei; Tang, Mingye; Ji, Shan; Shi, Jie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究硒诱导结直肠癌细胞铁死亡，涉及Nrf2/Gpx4蛋白与硒的分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality globally, necessitating novel therapeutic strategies. This study demonstrates that high-dose sodium selenite (Na(2)SeO(3)) induces ferroptosis in CRC cells by directly targeting the Nrf2/Gpx4 antioxidant pathway. Critically, molecular docking analysis confirmed strong binding interactions between Na(2)SeO(3) and both the Nrf2 and Gpx4 proteins, suggesting a direct mechanistic link. Clinical samples from CRC patients revealed significantly decreased serum selenium levels, which correlated negatively with tumor markers (CEA, CA199, CA125) and positively with nutritional indicators (hemoglobin, albumin). Immunohistochemistry confirmed elevated Gpx4 and Nrf2 expression in tumor tissues. In vitro experiments using HCT116 cells showed that Na(2)SeO(3) treatment inhibited proliferation, increased intracellular Fe(2)(+), MDA, and ROS levels, and reduced mitochondrial membrane potential. Western blotting further revealed the downregulation of Nrf2 and Gpx4 proteins upon selenium treatment. Our research findings indicate that sodium selenite may induce ferroptosis by regulating the Nrf2/Gpx4 axis, highlighting its potential as a dual nutrient and pharmacological drug for the treatment of CRC.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，亟需新的治疗策略。本研究证明，高剂量亚硒酸钠（Na(2)SeO(3)）通过直接靶向Nrf2/Gpx4抗氧化通路，在CRC细胞中诱导铁死亡（ferroptosis）。关键的是，分子对接分析确认了Na(2)SeO(3)与Nrf2和Gpx4蛋白之间的强结合相互作用，提示存在直接的机制联系。来自CRC患者的临床样本显示，血清硒水平显著降低，且与肿瘤标志物（CEA、CA199、CA125）呈负相关，与营养指标（血红蛋白、白蛋白）呈正相关。免疫组织化学证实，肿瘤组织中Gpx4和Nrf2表达升高。使用HCT116细胞的体外实验表明，Na(2)SeO(3)处理抑制了增殖，增加了细胞内Fe(2)(+)、MDA和ROS水平，并降低了线粒体膜电位。Western blotting进一步揭示，硒处理后Nrf2和Gpx4蛋白下调。我们的研究结果表明，亚硒酸钠可能通过调节Nrf2/Gpx4轴诱导铁死亡，凸显其作为治疗CRC的双重营养和药理药物的潜力。
